notes: Colors are exact: taken from the site's own :root custom properties (--dark-olive-green #3d521e, --peru #dc8c46, --peru-2 #aa5e1b, --white-smoke #eee, --212f0c, --translucent-white #ffffff1a, --felt-green-20 #7b9c48, --lime-green #edf1a3) plus the literal rgb() section fills in its stylesheet (rgb(54,71,28), rgb(52,69,28), rgb(45,63,19), rgb(68,91,35), rgb(236,235,229)). The page ground #3d521e is set inline on <body>. `craft.theme.supportsDark` reports true, but the payload is degenerate (accent rgba(0,0,0,0), fg #333 sampled from an iframe) — the site has no dark re-theme, it is already a dark page, so `color.dark` is omitted rather than invented. Type: the site declares display sizes in vw with no clamp() (7/6/5/4/3.5/2.5vw); `scale` lists the rem equivalents at a 1440px viewport, `fluid_scale` keeps the source units. Tracking is likewise declared in vw (-0.2vw at 7vw etc.) and has been normalized to em ratios. The raw profile's dominant `Arial 14px / line-height 20px` (676–743 occurrences) is iframe noise from embedded Vimeo/HubSpot players, not the site's body text — dropped. Likewise the raw color #333333 (501) and the lone box-shadow belong to those iframes' chrome; the shadow is kept because Webflow's lightbox uses it, but the page proper is shadowless. Radius 0px is the real button/section value (Webflow's `.w-button` base); 4/6/8px appear only on media thumbnails. Only one easing keyword (`ease`) exists site-wide; no custom cubic-bezier. The hero and two feature sections showed Vimeo 'Player error' voids during capture — those flat green rectangles in desktop.png are failed embeds, not design. `@keyframes spin` drives nothing on this page; the ticker is JS-driven translate3d.
